title: Run one bounded live GMGN discovery and Helius analysis smoke
objective: Execute exactly one operator-authorized live daily workflow using the already configured current-user DPAPI credentials: one fixed pinned gmgn-cli Solana discovery invocation for tokens created no more than 24 hours ago with provider-reported market cap strictly above USD 1,000,000, select the market-cap-descending top 5 to 10 without padding, strictly validate all CAs before any Helius source construction, then run the existing bounded read-only Helius analysis. Record only a sanitized acceptance summary and the sanitized report path; do not persist raw provider payloads, arbitrary errors, credentials or credential-bearing URLs.
forbidden_actions: Do not run more than one live daily discovery/analysis invocation.
Do not call a chain other than Solana, a discovery provider other than GMGN, or a chain-data provider other than Helius.
Do not run any trading, signing, swap, order, cooking, recommendation or transaction command.
Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw GMGN or Helius payloads, arbitrary provider text or full exception text.
Do not write a database, cache, queue, address library or production system and do not register or modify a scheduled task.
Do not pad a result below five candidates or guess, substitute, recommend or automatically discover outside the fixed bounded query.
Do not describe GMGN holder, concentration, creator, Dev or risk fields as independently verified Helius facts.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set except for the feature's sanitized local report under the current user's LOCALAPPDATA report directory.
